_comment: KRouter AI Gateway — Pterodactyl Egg (PTDL_v2). Import this file into the Pterodactyl panel via Nests → Eggs → Import.
name: KRouter AI Gateway
author: Yz776
description:
Bun + ElysiaJS AI Gateway — multi-provider router with OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible API, OAuth support, streaming, tool calling, failover routing, combos, token saver, observability, and a dashboard.

The install script automatically installs Bun, clones the repo, and installs dependencies. Persistent data (SQLite DBs + config) lives under /home/container/data.

Default login: admin / password123 (change it immediately after first boot).
startup: export PATH="/home/container/.bun/bin:$PATH" && cd /home/container/zrouter && exec bun run src/index.ts

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# KRouter Pterodactyl install script
# Runs inside a node:20-bookworm container; /home/container is mounted as persistent storage.
set -e

cd /home/container

echo "[install] === KRouter Pterodactyl installer ==="

# --- 1. Install Bun to the persistent volume so it survives restarts ----------
if [ -x "/home/container/.bun/bin/bun" ]; then
    echo "[install] Bun already installed at /home/container/.bun — skipping."
else
    echo "[install] Installing Bun to /home/container/.bun ..."
    export BUN_INSTALL="/home/container/.bun"
    curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
fi
export BUN_INSTALL="/home/container/.bun"
export PATH="/home/container/.bun/bin:$PATH"
bun --version

# --- 2. Clone or update the KRouter repository ------------------------------
REPO_URL="${GIT_REPO_URL:-https://github.com/Yz776/zrouter.git}"
REPO_BRANCH="${GIT_REPO_BRANCH:-main}"

if [ -d "/home/container/zrouter/.git" ]; then
    echo "[install] Updating existing repository ..."
    cd /home/container/zrouter
    git remote set-url origin "$REPO_URL"
    git fetch --all --prune
    git reset --hard "origin/$REPO_BRANCH"
    git pull origin "$REPO_BRANCH" || true
else
    echo "[install] Cloning $REPO_URL (branch: $REPO_BRANCH) ..."
    rm -rf /home/container/zrouter
    git clone --depth 1 -b "$REPO_BRANCH" "$REPO_URL" /home/container/zrouter
    cd /home/container/zrouter
fi

# --- 3. Prepare the persistent data directory ------------------------------
mkdir -p /home/container/data /home/container/logs
echo "[install] Data directory: /home/container/data"

# --- 4. Install dependencies (skip Puppeteer's Chromium download) -----------
export PUPPETEER_SKIP_CHROMIUM_DOWNLOAD=true
export PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=true
export BUN_ENV=production
export NODE_ENV=production

echo "[install] Running bun install ..."
bun install --production

echo "[install] === Installation complete ==="
echo "[install] KRouter is ready. Start the server from the panel."
echo "[install] Default login: admin / password123 (change it after first boot)"

variables.name: Server Port
variables.description: The port KRouter listens on. Auto-assigned by Pterodactyl from the server's primary allocation.

variables.name: Bind Host
variables.description: Network interface to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces (required for Pterodactyl).

variables.name: Data Directory
variables.description: Where KRouter stores its SQLite databases and config.json. Leave as default to keep data persistent across restarts.

variables.name: Git Repository URL
variables.description: The Git repository to clone during installation. Change this to use a fork or private repo (the install script will use it on reinstall).

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to clone from the repository.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Secret used to sign session cookies. Generate a strong random string (min 32 chars). Changing this will invalidate all existing sessions.

variables.name: Rate Limit (req/min)
variables.description: Maximum requests per minute per API key. Set 0 for unlimited.

variables.name: Admin Username
variables.description: Optional. If set together with ADMIN_PASSWORD, the default admin user is created with these credentials instead of admin/password123. Only applies on a fresh database.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Optional. Password for the admin user created on a fresh database. If empty, the default admin/password123 is used. MUST be changed after first login.
